phase1_edge_cases.name: Edge-Case Validation
phase1_edge_cases.description: Comprehensive edge-case coverage across API and browser layers including empty payloads, invalid auth, timeouts, rate limiting, SQL errors, and listener management.
keyFindings: Error responses properly normalized (400, 401, 200 with error payload)
Timeout handling graceful with proper client messaging
SQL error transport normalized to HTTP 200 (no 500 bleeds)
Judge0 timeout/unavailability handled with controlled response
AI timeout or fallback path gracefully aborted

phase2_soak_session.name: Long-Session Stability Soak (20-30 min)
phase2_soak_session.reason: Browser integration timeout during Playwright context initialization. Script hung during extended session cycles. This phase requires Playwright headless browser support for full telemetry collection.
phase2_soak_session.note: Desktop testing via API and edge-cases passed; browser-based soak cycle unable to complete in this environment.
phase2_soak_session.deferredTo: Full CI/CD pipeline with Docker support

phase3_concurrency.name: Concurrency & Load Testing
keyFindings: Parallel AI requests: 5/24 passed (throttled by rate limit) - EXPECTED
Parallel code execution: 40/40 returned 429 rate-limit responses - CORRECT BEHAVIOR
Scheduler and analytics polling: 80/80 passed (100%) - PASS
Rate-limit enforcement: All 140 concurrent burst requests properly rate-limited with 429 status and retry-after headers
System properly rejects excessive concurrent load according to configured limits (80 req/min for execution, 300 req/min default)
phase3_concurrency.interpretation: The 'failure' on code execution requests is actually the rate-limiting working as designed. The system correctly returns 429 (Too Many Requests) when concurrency exceeds configured thresholds. This validates that rate limiting is active and functioning—a PASS for production safety.

phase4_production.name: Production-Mode Verification

failedChecks_details.impact: Judge0 integration unavailable for code submissions
failedChecks_details.remediation: REQUIRED: Set JUDGE0_API_URL and JUDGE0_API_KEY in .env

failedChecks_details.check: Readiness confirms Postgres and Redis connectivity
failedChecks_details.issue: Redis running in degraded mode (expected for local dev, fallback active)
failedChecks_details.impact: Session management using in-memory storage instead of Redis cache
failedChecks_details.remediation: OPTIONAL: Start Redis service for full feature set, or accept degraded mode for local testing

failedChecks_details.check: Execution run endpoint works in production mode
failedChecks_details.remediation: REQUIRED: Ensure Piston service running or disable Piston, fall back to Judge0

passingChecks_summary: AI provider configuration: OK (Gemini, OpenRouter, Ollama all configured)
Health endpoints: All responding (health, liveness, readiness, AI health)
Judge0 connectivity via submit endpoint: OK

phase5_final_verdict.name: Aggregated GO/NO-GO Decision
phase5_final_verdict.reason: Score below 95% threshold. Three blocking issues in production verification phase must be resolved.

blockers.title: Judge0 environment configuration missing
blockers.description: JUDGE0_API_URL not configured in .env or .env.local. Code submission feature unavailable.
blockers.impact: Cannot submit code to Judge0 for automated testing and verification.

remediation.step1: Ensure Judge0 service running or accessible at configured URL
remediation.step3: Re-run Phase 4 production check to verify

blockers.title: Piston code execution unavailable (status 500)
blockers.description: Code execution endpoint returning 500 errors. Piston service connectivity failed.
blockers.impact: Cannot execute code snippets via the primary execution path.

remediation.step1: Verify Piston service is running (docker compose or standalone)
remediation.step2: Check Piston endpoint configuration in server/execution/piston.js
remediation.step3: Alternatively: Disable Piston and rely on Judge0 as fallback

blockers.title: Redis running in degraded mode
blockers.description: Redis unavailable; system falling back to in-memory session storage. Session persistence and caching disabled.
blockers.impact: Session data not persisted across server restarts. Clustering/multi-instance deployment not supported.

remediation.option1: Start Redis service (redis-server or docker) for production deployment
remediation.option2: Accept degraded mode for local development only (IN-MEMORY fallback is acceptable for testing, NOT for production)

critical: Piston execution service connectivity (Code execution path BLOCKER)
Judge0 environment configuration incomplete (Code submission path BLOCKER)
high: Redis unavailability in production (Session persistence risk)
Browser-based soak session incomplete (Performance degradation unknown)
medium: Rate-limit test misinterpretation (Was falsely reported as failure; actually validation of rate-limit correctness)
AI timeout injection handling works correctly but not fully load-tested
